caseName: Calambro ex rel. Calambro v. Ignacio
caseNameFull: Calambro, as Next Friend of Calambro v. Ignacio, Warden

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice O’Connor, and by her referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens would grant the application for stay of execution.
